headline: As of 2026-10-23: 24,234,449 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 46 of 50 states, D+12.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 24,234,449 early/mail ballots cast so far across 46 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+12.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (3,113,846), California (2,640,634), Florida (2,302,903).
